description:
The subject requirement is for the acquisition of NSN 6116013697679 (FUEL CELL, ELECTRICAL).

CAGE    MANUFACTURER                          PART_NUMBER

21070    TELEDYNE INSTRUMENTS INC     C06689-B3M

DLA L&M proposes to enter into fixed-price contract(s) with an annual price adjustment provisions to adjust out-year contract prices. The resulting contract(s) will be long-term indefinite quantity contract(s), which includes a 1-year base period and two 1-year options for a total of three years. This acquisition is for a Indefinite Delivery Purchase Order (IDPO) using Simplified Procedures for the Acquisition of Commercial Products.

Applicable NAICS is 334413 and Small Business Size Standard is 1250.

The solicitation will be available on March 16, 2026, at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/rfp/. Increments and delivery schedule will be noted on the RFP. This solicitation will be FOB Destination and Inspection/acceptance at destination. All responsible sources may submit a quote, which shall be considered.
